items.name: The Nairobi Open 2023
items.information: Welcome. This will be the 5th official competition in Nairobi... we hope to see everyone in large numbers!

items.name: Hike 2 Cube Kenya 2023
items.information:
Welcome! This will be the world's first ever WCA competition on top of a mountain!

Please go through each and every tab for all the information about this trip, and let the organiser know about any specific quiries you may have.

We will be hiking to the top of Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo). It is going to be a 9 kilometer walk to the top, and another 9 to come back down...

This competition is recommended for only competitors aged 12 and above. Those who are aged younger may have difficulties walking long distances.

It will be a road trip from the capital, Nairobi, to the venue in Machakos, and back. 

Competitors also have the option to drive up the mountain (provided they have their own personal vehicles) incase they are not in a position to hike. Make sure to inform the organiser in advance if this will be the case.

We will be glad to see all the cubers from around this region, and you'll all have a great time.

More information under their respective tabs.

items.name: The Peponi House Twist & Turn 2023

venue.name: Peponi House Preparatory School
venue.address: Peponi House Preparatory School, Farasi Lane, Nairobi, Kenya

items.information:
Welcome to the third WCA competition in Kenya! 
This competition is specifically created for those who are aged 13 and under. Those who are aged 14 and above can participate... but will not qualify to get a prize on the podium.

Participants should bring some form of identification in order to confirm that they are aged 13 and below. A passport, or a copy of your birth cirtificate is a good example since it shows name, age, nationality and so on.  

You only need to be present at the venue during the events in which you plan to attend. However, you need to be present at the venue no later than 15 minutes before your first event starts so that you have enough time to complete the registration.

items.name: Navitas Cube Challenge Kenya 2022

venue.name: Park Inn by Radisson
venue.address: Park Inn by Radisson Nairobi Westlands

items.information:
Welcome to the second WCA competition in Kenya! More information under the respective tabs.
New participants should bring some form of identification in order to confirm the information given during the registration. A passport is a good example since it shows name, age, nationality and so on.

You only need to be present at the venue during the events in which you plan to attend. However, you need to be present at the venue no later than 15 minutes before your first event starts so that you have enough time to complete the registration. A few days before the competition, you will receive a participant email where we will address various important information for participants to know.
